annotations.title: Search the full text of the Journal Officiel

description: Search the full text of the acts published in the Algerian Journal Officiel since 1962 (French edition: laws, ordinances, presidential and executive decrees, orders, decisions, Bank of Algeria regulations, corrigenda), not only their titles. Each match gives the year, the issue, the place of the act in the issue (ord), its type, its number when it has one, its title, its first page, an excerpt around the words and the links to the issue page and the official PDF; get_jo_act then returns the whole text. Words are matched in French with accents and case ignored and plurals folded (for example "redevance dossiers investissement"); quotes search an exact phrase, OR offers alternatives and a leading minus excludes a word. Best matches first. Use it to find which text sets a rule, a rate, an amount or a procedure, then read that text with get_jo_act before quoting it. The text is the official one as published: an act amended since appears as it was printed. From 2002 the text is the one of the official PDF (source pdf); from 1962 to 2001 it was read from the scans by three independent machine readings, each word kept when two of them agree (source scan), and a passage no two readings gave alike is marked [[? ... ?]] (uncertain counts them in an act): check such a passage on the PDF before quoting it. Without an API key, only the current year and the two before it, and at most 10 matches (meta.free_years, meta.truncated). Algeria only (country DZ); other countries return country_not_available.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

limit.description: Maximum number of results in the page, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 20. Without an API key at most 10 rows come back.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, from 0 to 10000, to read the next pages. Defaults to 0. meta.total tells how many results match. Without an API key it must be 0: a search cannot be paged.

q.description: Words to find in the text, accents and case ignored, for example redevance traitement dossiers investissement, or a phrase in quotes.

type.description: Only the acts of this kind.

year.description: Only the acts published that year (2002 or later).

name: search_jo_text
title: Search the full text of the Journal Officiel
